people.name: Cody Lee Ashton
people.bio_note: Managing Member, CCO, and co-founder. 17+ years in the industry (licensed advisor since 2008), with prior experience at Edward Jones, Apple Computer, and Raymond James Financial Services before co-founding Triton. Holds a bachelor's in information systems management from Weber State University. Raised in Lyman, Wyoming; lives in Surprise, AZ with wife Brooke and three sons; active in church service, the Lions Club, and youth sports coaching.

people.name: David Lee Dorsey
people.bio_note: Managing Member and co-founder. 24 years in the industry; born and raised in Beaumont, TX, attended Lamar University, then built his practice at Edward Jones Investments in Arizona, becoming a top producer there before co-founding Triton. Holds Series 63 and 66 licenses, registered in AZ and TX. Married to Kristen with four children; enjoys gourmet cooking, astronomy, fly fishing, and travel.

people.name: William Chad Mitton
people.bio_note: Managing Member and co-founder. 15 years in investment advisory; has mentored newer and veteran advisors across Arizona's West Valley. Fluent Spanish speaker who completed a two-year missionary service in Honduras; married to Adrianna with five children; coaches varsity football at a local high school.

firm_note.text: Triton Wealth Management, PLLC is a Sun City, AZ-based RIA founded in 2018. Equally owned by four Managing Members — Cody Ashton, David Dorsey, Michael Bird, and Chad Mitton — all former wirehouse/independent-channel advisors (Edward Jones, Raymond James, Charles Schwab custody) who consolidated their practices into a fee-based fiduciary firm.
